#algori refresh celltype
```{r}
# supplementary celltype-specific algorithm CDF plot

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
})

wrap24 <- function(x) {
  ((x %% 24) + 24) %% 24
}

# Step 1. Load merged algorithm benchmark metadata
meta_df <- read_csv(
  "~/scRhythmBayes/data/meta_data_algorithm_benchmark_current_package_SRB.csv"
)

# Step 2. Set output path
out_dir <- "~/scRhythmBayes/data/Benchmark/algorithm_benchmark_current_package_SRB"
plot_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "plots_cell_phase_by_celltype")

dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Step 3. Define algorithms and colors
method_vec <- c(
  "ZT_scRhythmBayes",
  "ZT_cyclops",
  "ZT_tempo",
  "ZT_cyclum"
)

method_label <- c(
  "ZT_scRhythmBayes" = "SRB",
  "ZT_cyclops" = "CP",
  "ZT_tempo" = "TP",
  "ZT_cyclum" = "CM"
)

method_cols <- c(
  "ZT_scRhythmBayes" = "#A8C7E6",
  "ZT_tempo" = "#F0918E",
  "ZT_cyclops" = "#D591B4",
  "ZT_cyclum" = "#DEBCD9"
)

celltype_vec <- sort(unique(meta_df$celltype))

# Step 4. Calculate AUC, MedAE, and CDF for each cell type and each algorithm
auc_all <- list()
cdf_all <- list()

run_id <- 1

for (celltype_i in celltype_vec) {
  
  meta_i <- meta_df %>%
    filter(celltype == celltype_i)
  
  for (method_i in method_vec) {
    
    message("Processing celltype = ", celltype_i, " | method = ", method_i)
    
    true_h <- as.numeric(meta_i$t_true)
    pred_h <- as.numeric(meta_i[[method_i]])
    
    diff_h <- abs((pred_h - true_h) %% 24)
    err_h <- pmin(diff_h, 24 - diff_h)
    err_h <- sort(err_h)
    
    hrsoff <- c(0, err_h, 12)
    
    frac_wrong <- sapply(
      hrsoff,
      function(hrtol) {
        100 * sum(err_h > hrtol) / length(err_h)
      }
    )
    
    pct_correct <- 100 - frac_wrong
    
    norm_pct_correct <- pct_correct / 100
    norm_hrsoff <- hrsoff / 12
    
    auc <- sum(norm_pct_correct[-length(norm_pct_correct)] * diff(norm_hrsoff))
    medae <- median(err_h)
    
    auc_i <- tibble(
      celltype = celltype_i,
      method = method_i,
      method_label = method_label[method_i],
      AUC = auc,
      MedAE = medae,
      n_cell = length(err_h)
    )
    
    cdf_i <- tibble(
      celltype = celltype_i,
      method = method_i,
      method_label = method_label[method_i],
      threshold_h = hrsoff,
      pct_correct = pct_correct
    )
    
    auc_all[[run_id]] <- auc_i
    cdf_all[[run_id]] <- cdf_i
    
    run_id <- run_id + 1
  }
}

auc_all <- bind_rows(auc_all)
cdf_all <- bind_rows(cdf_all)

auc_all

write_csv(
  auc_all,
  file.path(out_dir, "algorithm_auc_medae_by_celltype_current_package_SRB.csv")
)

saveRDS(
  auc_all,
  file.path(out_dir, "algorithm_auc_medae_by_celltype_current_package_SRB.rds")
)

write_csv(
  cdf_all,
  file.path(out_dir, "algorithm_cdf_by_celltype_current_package_SRB.csv")
)

saveRDS(
  cdf_all,
  file.path(out_dir, "algorithm_cdf_by_celltype_current_package_SRB.rds")
)

# Step 5. Build fixed-grid CDF curves
threshold_grid <- seq(0, 12, by = 0.05)

cdf_grid_all <- list()
grid_id <- 1

for (celltype_i in celltype_vec) {
  
  meta_i <- meta_df %>%
    filter(celltype == celltype_i)
  
  for (method_i in method_vec) {
    
    true_h <- as.numeric(meta_i$t_true)
    pred_h <- as.numeric(meta_i[[method_i]])
    
    diff_h <- abs((pred_h - true_h) %% 24)
    err_h <- pmin(diff_h, 24 - diff_h)
    
    pct_correct <- sapply(
      threshold_grid,
      function(hrtol) {
        100 * sum(err_h <= hrtol) / length(err_h)
      }
    )
    
    cdf_grid_i <- tibble(
      celltype = celltype_i,
      method = method_i,
      method_label = method_label[method_i],
      threshold_h = threshold_grid,
      pct_correct = pct_correct
    )
    
    cdf_grid_all[[grid_id]] <- cdf_grid_i
    
    grid_id <- grid_id + 1
  }
}

cdf_grid_all <- bind_rows(cdf_grid_all)

write_csv(
  cdf_grid_all,
  file.path(out_dir, "algorithm_cdf_grid_by_celltype_current_package_SRB.csv")
)

saveRDS(
  cdf_grid_all,
  file.path(out_dir, "algorithm_cdf_grid_by_celltype_current_package_SRB.rds")
)

# Step 6. Plot one CDF panel for each cell type
for (celltype_i in celltype_vec) {
  
  meta_i <- meta_df %>%
    filter(celltype == celltype_i)
  
  auc_i_all <- auc_all %>%
    filter(celltype == celltype_i)
  
  cdf_i_all <- cdf_grid_all %>%
    filter(celltype == celltype_i)
  
  legend_labels <- c()
  
  for (method_i in method_vec) {
    
    auc_i <- auc_i_all %>%
      filter(method == method_i)
    
    label_i <- paste0(
      method_label[method_i],
      ": ",
      sprintf("%.3f", auc_i$AUC),
      ", ",
      sprintf("%.3f", auc_i$MedAE)
    )
    
    legend_labels <- c(legend_labels, label_i)
  }
  
  # TIFF
  tiff(
    filename = file.path(
      plot_dir,
      paste0("algorithm_cell_phase_cdf_celltype", celltype_i, "_current_package_SRB.tiff")
    ),
    width = 3.2,
    height = 3.2,
    units = "in",
    res = 300,
    compression = "lzw"
  )
  
  par(
    family = "serif",
    mar = c(4, 4, 2.5, 1),
    mgp = c(2.1, 0.55, 0),
    tcl = -0.25,
    lwd = 0.5
  )
  
  plot(
    NA,
    xlim = c(-0.3, 12.5),
    ylim = c(-2, 102),
    xlab = "Correct to within (hrs)",
    ylab = paste0("% correct (N = ", nrow(meta_i), ")"),
    main = paste0("Cell type ", celltype_i),
    cex.main = 0.9,
    cex.lab = 0.8,
    cex.axis = 0.75,
    bty = "n"
  )
  
  box(lwd = 0.5)
  
  abline(
    a = 0,
    b = 100 / 12,
    col = "lightgray",
    lwd = 0.7
  )
  
  for (method_i in c("ZT_cyclops", "ZT_tempo", "ZT_cyclum", "ZT_scRhythmBayes")) {
    
    cdf_i <- cdf_i_all %>%
      filter(method == method_i)
    
    lines(
      cdf_i$threshold_h,
      cdf_i$pct_correct,
      col = method_cols[method_i],
      lwd = 1.2
    )
  }
  
  legend(
    "bottomright",
    legend = c("        AUC, MedAE", legend_labels),
    col = c(NA, method_cols[method_vec]),
    lwd = c(NA, rep(1.2, length(method_vec))),
    bty = "o",
    box.lwd = 0.3,
    cex = 0.62,
    y.intersp = 0.9
  )
  
  dev.off()
  
  # PDF
  pdf(
    file = file.path(
      plot_dir,
      paste0("algorithm_cell_phase_cdf_celltype", celltype_i, "_current_package_SRB.pdf")
    ),
    width = 3.2,
    height = 3.2
  )
  
  par(
    family = "serif",
    mar = c(4, 4, 2.5, 1),
    mgp = c(2.1, 0.55, 0),
    tcl = -0.25,
    lwd = 0.5
  )
  
  plot(
    NA,
    xlim = c(-0.3, 12.5),
    ylim = c(-2, 102),
    xlab = "Correct to within (hrs)",
    ylab = paste0("% correct (N = ", nrow(meta_i), ")"),
    main = paste0("Cell type ", celltype_i),
    cex.main = 0.9,
    cex.lab = 0.8,
    cex.axis = 0.75,
    bty = "n"
  )
  
  box(lwd = 0.5)
  
  abline(
    a = 0,
    b = 100 / 12,
    col = "lightgray",
    lwd = 0.7
  )
  
  for (method_i in c("ZT_cyclops", "ZT_tempo", "ZT_cyclum", "ZT_scRhythmBayes")) {
    
    cdf_i <- cdf_i_all %>%
      filter(method == method_i)
    
    lines(
      cdf_i$threshold_h,
      cdf_i$pct_correct,
      col = method_cols[method_i],
      lwd = 1.2
    )
  }
  
  legend(
    "bottomright",
    legend = c("        AUC, MedAE", legend_labels),
    col = c(NA, method_cols[method_vec]),
    lwd = c(NA, rep(1.2, length(method_vec))),
    bty = "o",
    box.lwd = 0.3,
    cex = 0.62,
    y.intersp = 0.9
  )
  
  dev.off()
}

# Step 7. Save a compact summary table
auc_summary_by_celltype <- auc_all %>%
  arrange(celltype, desc(AUC))

write_csv(
  auc_summary_by_celltype,
  file.path(out_dir, "algorithm_auc_medae_by_celltype_summary_current_package_SRB.csv")
)
```
